title: Mitohometic Responses in Larvae Fed 1:16 P:C Food
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rtfd6jn
materials: For inhibitors, freshly prepared aldose reductase (polyol pathway) inhibitor (Epalrestat, Sigma SML0527) and carnitine palmitoyltransferase-1 inhibitor (Etomoxir, Sigma E1905) were solubilised in water to prepare a 5 mM stock.
Glycolysis inhibitor (2-Deoxy-D-Glucose, Sigma D8375) was solubilised in water to prepare a 500mM stock.
The stock solutions were added to the 1:2 and 1:16 P:C diets to final concentrations of 25 µM Epalrestat, 12.5 µM Etomoxir and 5mM 2-Deoxy-D-Glucose.

Then, 200 ml of food was combined with 1.868 g of either sucrose (Sigma S0389) as the control, sorbitol (Sigma S1876), fructose (Sigma F0127), mannose (Sigma M6020), fucose (Sigma F2252), xylose (Sigma X3877) or gluconate (Sigma G1951). Each new diet was poured into 8 bottles.

steps.title: Collect and prepare eggs
steps.instruction: Release approximately 100, 3-4 day old flies of each mitotype into population cages to lay eggs on Petri plates containing 4% agar and 10% treacle supplemented with yeast.

steps.title: Assign eggs to diets
steps.instruction: Place equivalent numbers of eggs onto bottles containing either 1:2 or 1:16 P:C food with inhibitors added.

steps.title: Prepare sucrose-free diet variant
steps.instruction: For specific hypothesis testing, prepare the 1:16 P:C diet without the addition of sucrose to replace sucrose as the dietary sugar.

steps.title: Inoculate and incubate larvae
steps.instruction: Add equal amounts of eggs harbouring Alstonville or Dahomey mtDNA to each diet and maintain under specific environmental conditions.

substeps.instruction: Keep flies at 23° C and 50% humidity on a 12 h light/dark cycle.

steps.title: Monitor and record eclosion
steps.instruction: Count emerging adult female flies over a 3 day window to calculate and record the percentage eclosion of each mitotype.
